source_refs.quoted_text:
## Scope
This claim applies only to the retained post-screening subset of 20 intact boxes and not to the complete planned set of 24 boxes, which includes 4 damaged boxes excluded before analysis.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to demonstrate the issue by looking for any statement attributing the 35.0% rate to the complete planned set of 24 boxes, and by recomputing all counts from inputs/data.csv. The recount (24 planned, 4 damaged, 20 intact, 7 occupied among intact) matches the report exactly, the declared scientific target in task.md is the retained subset, and the report's scope section explicitly excludes the complete planned set. No mismatch between claimed domain and analysis denominator exists, so the issue class cannot be demonstrated.
